issues.subtopic_definition: Account hacked, stolen, disabled, banned or locked; unauthorised account changes
issues.name: Account hacked and playlists unrecoverable
issues.description: The customer says their account was hacked and they cannot recover playlists they had set up.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot log in or stay logged in; forced logouts; password reset fails
issues.name: Unable to log in or stay logged in
issues.description: Customers cannot log in, get logged out unexpectedly, or find password and login attempts keep failing.

issues.subtopic_definition: Unexpected, duplicate or post-cancellation charges, refunds, payment problems
issues.name: Unexpected charges for listening
issues.description: The customer feels they are being charged in ways they did not expect when listening to or replaying music.

issues.subtopic_definition: Premium-only controls: forced shuffle, skip limits, can't pick songs, features moved behind the paywall
issues.name: Free users restricted by premium-only controls
issues.description: Free users find skips, song picking, repeat and other basic features limited or locked behind premium.

issues.subtopic_definition: Paid premium not activating, premium benefits missing, plan/trial not applied, cancellation difficulty
issues.name: Premium purchase not activating or applying
issues.description: Customers who paid or tried to subscribe to premium find it does not activate, benefits are missing, or the purchase prompt fails.
issues.note: Mixes failed purchase attempts with activated premium that still lacks access and lagging premium podcasts.

issues.subtopic_definition: Price too high, price increases, value for money, student/family plan pricing
issues.name: Premium pricing seen as too high
issues.description: Customers feel premium costs too much for the value, especially for features once free.

issues.subtopic_definition: Platform content decisions, artist bans, political or moral objections tied to content
issues.name: Objections to platform content decisions
issues.description: Customers object to how Spotify handles certain artists' streams and to the types of creators hosted on the platform.
issues.note: Mixes an artist-chart fairness complaint with an objection to hosting specific commentators.

issues.subtopic_definition: Lyrics missing, paywalled or out of sync
issues.name: Lyrics fail to load or appear inconsistently
issues.description: Lyrics stop loading or are missing for some songs but present for others.

issues.subtopic_definition: Songs, albums, artists or podcasts missing, greyed out, removed or region-locked
issues.name: Songs and features missing from catalog
issues.description: Customers find songs, Canvas visuals, or Wrapped content missing or unavailable.
issues.note: Mixes missing songs with Canvas and Wrapped feature absence and general dislike of music quality.

issues.subtopic_definition: Recommendations, algorithm, repetitive suggestions, Discover Weekly, autoplay/radio picks, shuffle repeating songs
issues.name: Unwanted or repetitive song recommendations
issues.description: Customers are frustrated by recommended songs they dislike or repeated suggestions that ignore their settings.

issues.subtopic_definition: Cannot download, downloads stuck, offline mode not working
issues.name: Downloads and offline mode not working
issues.description: Customers cannot download music or the offline mode fails to work.

issues.subtopic_definition: Downloaded/saved music or liked songs disappear or must be re-downloaded
issues.name: Downloaded music disappears and must be redownloaded
issues.description: Downloaded favourites vanish periodically, forcing customers to download them again.

issues.subtopic_definition: General criticism or 'bad app' without a specific supported topic
issues.name: General dissatisfaction with the app
issues.description: Customers express broad negative opinions about the app or recent updates without naming a specific problem.

issues.subtopic_definition: Unrelated, meaningless, unsupported-language, or boycott-slogan text
issues.name: Unrelated or boycott-driven negative text
issues.description: Reviews contain boycott slogans, off-topic remarks, or unclear text not tied to a specific product problem.
issues.note: Mixes boycott slogans, off-topic comparisons, and unclear negative remarks.

issues.subtopic_definition: Sound quality, volume levels, equalizer, audio glitches
issues.name: Audio glitches and volume control problems
issues.description: Customers report noise, volume adjustment not working, or the app shouting during playback.

issues.subtopic_definition: 'No internet connection'/offline errors while online, failure to load or buffer
issues.name: False no-internet errors while online
issues.description: The app reports no internet connection or fails to load content even though the customer's connection works.

issues.subtopic_definition: App crashes, freezes, won't open, black screen
issues.name: App crashes, freezes, or won't load
issues.description: The app crashes, freezes on a loading screen, shows a black screen, or stops playback after updates.

issues.subtopic_definition: Bluetooth, car, Android Auto, Chromecast, Connect, smart speakers, watches
issues.name: Failures connecting to other devices
issues.description: Customers cannot cast, connect to smart speakers or assistants, or play through other devices reliably.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other playback issue
issues.name: Lyrics and repeat controls fail during playback
issues.description: Customers report lyrics not loading on playlists and inability to repeat or play specific parts of songs.
issues.note: Mixes a lyrics-loading problem with a repeat and seek control complaint.

issues.subtopic_definition: Slow, laggy, battery drain, data or storage usage, overheating
issues.name: Background downloads drain resources
issues.description: Customers say the app keeps downloading in the background and wastes data and storage.
issues.note: Mixes a background download issue with a general data and storage waste complaint.

issues.subtopic_definition: Music stops, pauses, skips or jumps by itself; songs won't play
issues.name: Music stops, pauses, or changes on its own
issues.description: Songs pause, stop mid-show, or switch to different tracks without the customer choosing.

issues.subtopic_definition: Too many, too long, too loud or repeated ads interrupting listening
issues.name: Too many and unskippable ads
issues.description: Customers feel ads are too frequent, too long, or unskippable, interrupting their listening.

issues.subtopic_definition: Buttons, gestures, lockscreen/notification controls, widgets, sleep timer, settings
issues.name: Cannot rewind or go back a few seconds
issues.description: Customers cannot step back a few seconds in a track after an update.

issues.subtopic_definition: Managing playlists, library, liked songs, queue order, sorting, editing
issues.name: Playlist and shuffle behaviour ignores user choice
issues.description: Playlists and liked songs play random or repeated tracks, and users cannot choose specific songs or view their liked list.
issues.note: Mixes shuffle and playback order issues with liked songs view problems.

issues.subtopic_definition: Other usability issue not covered above
issues.name: Too many restrictions in the app
issues.description: The customer feels the app imposes excessive restrictions on how they use it.

issues.subtopic_definition: Layout, redesigns, home feed, finding things, confusing navigation, design changes
issues.name: Layout redesigns make the app harder to use
issues.description: Customers find recent layout and home screen redesigns confusing, slow to navigate, and less user-friendly.
